title: 第9章 商会总管
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
武者修行，想要持续变强，除了借助各种材料熬炼肉身之外，更离不开功法的辅佐。

    强大的功法，不仅能夯实武者的根基，更能挖掘其潜力，令其实力大涨。

    当然，不同的功法，带来的助益也截然不同。

    例如陆舟手中的玄元镇岳诀。

    修炼有成后，将气血转化为玄元内力，壮大自身的同时，还能够利用玄元内力强化攻击，镇岳吞天。

    这是一门一力降十会的强大功法，霸道绝伦！

    只可惜，他手中功法是残缺的，只有上卷和中卷，下卷缺失了一部分。

    按照上面介绍……

    上卷和中卷侧重于借助玄元内力强化肉身，下卷则更多集中在对玄元内力的深化，以达到撼动山河之能！

    下卷很关键！

    好在系统能够弥补这缺失的下卷。

    陆舟看向系统。

    【是否消耗50万两白银补全整本功法？】

    系统提示音，随之响起。

    他心头微动。

    五十万两白银！

    相当于自己只用一百五十万两就买下了一本完整的一流高阶功法。

    要知道，市面上这等品质的功法，少说也得四五百万，甚至有价无市。

    自己简直血赚！

    陆舟手里还剩下一百多万两白银，能直接补全功法。

    但他不急，打算再看看武技和其他武道资源，争取把钱全部转化为战力！

    收起功法，陆舟注意到，右手的李雄脸有些微微红，右手正端着酒杯，一杯入肚，表情惬意。

    至于左手的周川，则正襟危坐，气度沉稳。

    只是察觉到陆舟目光后，疑惑看了过来。

    “王爷，可是有什么吩咐？”他轻声询问。

    一旁的李雄也立刻放下酒杯，收敛醉态，神色肃然。

    “没什么。”心情不错的陆舟，笑了笑：“就是想着你们应该也缺功法武技吧？等会儿去挑一挑，算我送的。”

    他有心拉拢二人，适当的时候，总得拿出足够的诚意。

    闻言，周川和李雄同时变了脸色，眼中满是震惊。

    二人出身底层军旅，无权无势，手中功法武技皆是军中配发或是家中祖传，根本舍不得花巨额银两另寻上乘传承。

    毕竟，银两都要砸在大量的修行资源上，熬炼肉身、提升境界。

    所以大多数时候，两人都不会考虑功法和武技，除非实在绕不过去。

    可现在，陆舟居然要送他们功法武技？

    这份恩情……太大了！

    周川陡然站起，连忙拱手抱拳，语气恳切：“王爷，属下何德何能受此重礼！还请您收回成命”
content_en:
If a warrior practices and wants to continue to become stronger, in addition to using various materials to refine his body, he cannot do without the assistance of martial arts.

    Powerful techniques can not only solidify a warrior's foundation, but also tap into their potential, greatly increasing their strength.

    Of course, different exercises bring completely different benefits.

    For example, the Xuanyuan Zhenyue Jue in Lu Zhou's hand.

    After successful cultivation, Qi and blood can be converted into Xuanyuan internal force. While strengthening oneself, one can also use Xuanyuan internal force to strengthen attacks and subdue Yue Tiantian.

    This is a powerful technique that can defeat ten societies with one force. It is extremely domineering!

    It's a pity that the skill in his hand is incomplete, only the upper volume and the middle volume are missing, and part of the lower volume is missing.

    According to the above introduction...

    The first and middle volumes focus on strengthening the physical body with the help of Xuanyuan's internal power, while the second volume focuses more on deepening Xuanyuan's internal power in order to achieve the power to shake mountains and rivers!

    The next volume is crucial!

    Fortunately, the system can make up for this missing volume.

    Lu Zhou looked at the system.

    [Do you want to spend 500,000 taels of silver to complete the entire skill? 】

    The system prompt sounds immediately.

    His heart moved slightly.

    Five hundred thousand taels of silver!

    It is equivalent to buying a complete first-class high-level martial arts book for only 1.5 million taels.

    You know, a martial arts technique of this quality on the market costs at least four to five million, and it may even be expensive but not marketable.

    I've made a lot of money!

    Lu Zhou still has more than one million taels of silver left in his hand, which can directly complete the skills.

    But he is not in a hurry, he plans to look at martial arts and other martial arts resources again, and try to convert all the money into combat power!

    After putting away the technique, Lu Zhou noticed that Li Xiong's face was slightly red, and he was holding a wine glass in his right hand with a contented expression.

    As for Zhou Chuan on the left, he is sitting upright with a calm demeanor.

    But after noticing Lu Zhou's gaze, he looked over in confusion.

    "My lord, what are your orders?" he asked softly.

    Li Xiong on the side also immediately put down his wine glass, calmed down his drunkenness, and looked solemn.

    "It's nothing." Lu Zhou, who was in a good mood, smiled and said, "I just thought that you might also be lacking in martial arts and martial arts skills, right? I'll pick one up later, and I'll give it to you."

    He is determined to win over the two of them, and when the time comes, he must show enough sincerity.

    Hearing this, Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong's expressions changed at the same time, their eyes full of shock.

    The two of them came from a low-level military background and had no power or influence. All their martial arts and martial arts were distributed by the military or passed down from their families. They were unwilling to spend huge sums of money to find another superior inheritance.

    After all, all the money has to be spent on a large amount of cultivation resources to refine the body and improve the realm.

    So most of the time, the two of them would not consider exercises and martial arts unless they couldn't get around it.

    But now, Lu Zhou actually wants to give them martial arts skills?

    This kindness... is too great!

    Zhou Chuan stood up suddenly, hurriedly cupped his hands and clasped his fists, and said in a sincere tone: "Your Majesty, how can I accept this great gift! Please take back your life."
